summary: This note describes the fifth season of the TV series American Horror Story, set at the Downtown Los Angeles Hotel Cortez. The hotel was recently bought by New York fashion designer Will Drake and is haunted by ghosts and demons, including its founder James Patrick March. It also introduces the hotel's staff and residents, such as the vampire Elizabeth / The Countess and her lover Donovan.
one_line: Plot overview of the fifth season of American Horror Story, set in the haunted Downtown Los Angeles Hotel Cortez.
key_facts: The fifth season of American Horror Story focuses on the Downtown Los Angeles Hotel Cortez.
The Hotel Cortez was recently purchased by New York fashion designer Will Drake, played by Cheyenne Jackson.
The 90-year-old hotel is haunted by demons and mysterious ghosts.
The hotel's founder, James Patrick March, is played by Evan Peters.
Sally, a heroin junkie ghost, is played by Sarah Paulson.
The Addiction Demon is described as strap-on-wielding.
Elizabeth / The Countess, a 111-year-old vampire, is played by Lady Gaga.
Donovan, the Countess' longtime paramour and a former drug addict, is played by Matt Bomer.
Iris, Donovan's mother and the manager and front desk clerk, is played by Kathy Bates.
Liz Taylor, the eccentric transgender bartender, is played by Denis O'Hare.
Ramona Royale, the Countess' vengeance-obsessed lover, is played by Angela Bassett.
